data.question: What direct seed edges connect WEF, Trump, Vance, Larry Fink, BlackRock, Palantir and Peter Thiel?
data.method: Primary-source reconciliation against existing AutoDig entities and relations.
data.framework: Typed-edge analysis separating governance, partner status, event access, political appointment, employment, donations and beneficial ownership.
data.scope: Public records reviewed through 2026-07-29; all new records use dataset wef.
findings: Fink is a formal WEF governance node.
BlackRock and Palantir are listed on the 2026 WEF partner roster.
Trump has direct WEF event access and a documented advisory relationship with Fink.
Fink and Alex Karp were named speakers in a WEF session.
BlackRock's reported Palantir holdings create a capital edge but do not establish control.
Existing AutoDig records already establish Trump -> Vance -> Thiel -> Palantir.
conclusions: The supported model is overlapping institutional, political-capital and defense-technology networks, not one command structure.
Palantir is the strongest organization crossover; Thiel is the strongest Vance bridge; Fink is the strongest WEF-finance bridge.
recommendations: Expand Michael Kratsios, David Sacks, Jacob Helberg, Trae Stephens, Joe Lonsdale, Rockbridge, Founders Fund, Anduril, 8VC and PCAST.
counterarguments: Partner status, event participation and beneficial holdings do not prove coordination or policy control.
limitations: Non-public meetings and unpublished delegate lists are outside scope.
unresolved: Which named personnel have at least two independent paths back to the seed graph?

workflow.next_action: Run depth-1 personnel and institutional bridge expansion.
